correctness.rationale: The zonoid representation D_R=(R/2)∫[-eφ,eφ]dφ normalizes mixed zonotope V2 cross-minors and area=2V2; the fixed-ψ angular cross-product integral gives 2E(√(1-sin²θ sin²ψ)), producing A=2π(R²+S²)+8RS∫E. The defining E integrand is monotone in its modulus and hence strictly increases in θ. Complementary-modulus E expansion and beta integrals ∫sin²=π/4 and ∫sin²logsin=(π/8)(1-2log2) yield the displayed exact coefficient and controlled θ⁴ log remainder. Triple determinants give volume 2πRS(R+S)sinθ; support-function linearity gives mean width π(R+S)/2. The two-sided flat area limit differs from direct planar boundary H² at θ=0.

value.rationale: Natural global invariant of Minkowski sums of planar disks: exact area versus angle with a logarithmic non-C² collision as planes coalesce, sharply differing from analytic volume and constant mean width. Quantitative convex-geometry endpoint behavior is useful beyond an arbitrary numerical instance.

final_claim: For two centered noncoplanar disks of radii R,S>0 with acute angle 0<θ<=π/2, area is an elliptic integral, increases strictly in θ, and has πRS θ²(log(8/θ)-1)+O(θ⁴log(1/θ)) area excess; volume and mean width also explicit.
limitations: Only centered circular planar disks, positive radii and 0<θ<=π/2; θ=0 is one-sided 3D surface-area limit not 2D actual boundary measure.
